mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_project (member_id, repo_url, repo_owner, repo_name, description, primary_language, readme_text) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{repoUrl}, #{repoOwner}, #{repoName}, #{description}, #{primaryLanguage}, #{readmeText})
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, repo_url, repo_owner, repo_name, description, primary_language, readme_text, created_at FROM interview_project WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, member_id, repo_url, repo_owner, repo_name, description, primary_language, created_at FROM interview_project WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
